Harald Zwart (born 1 July 1965) is a Dutch-Norwegian 
director, writer and producer.
[1]Early life[edit]Although born in the Netherlands, Zwart was raised in 
Fredrikstad, Norway. By age eight, he had started making short films. He attended the Dutch Film Academy in Amsterdam where he received great acclaim for his student film 
Gabriel's Surprise. The film was later televised.

Gabriel's Surprise. The film was later televised.
